Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.

- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

About The Team

The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.

This is a primarily hands-on role with meaningful technical leadership and some project coordination responsibilities. You will work closely with Product, Data Management, and fellow engineers.

What You'll Do

At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of the balance of responsibilities:

Technical Design and Delivery (50%)

- Design and implement high-quality Java full-stack features and services that power Performance and Financial Insights

- Translate requirements into clear technical specifications and success criteria; contribute to architectural discussions
- Drive testing strategy for your areas of ownership, heavily leveraging Claude for unit, integration, and end-to-end test generation

Software and Data Engineering (30%)

- Write production-grade Java (Spring Boot) code and support front-end work
- Create and maintain data pipelines and transformations on Databricks
- Use Claude daily as a core tool for coding, refactoring, debugging, and writing robust integration tests

Collaboration & Mentorship (15%) 

- Mentor Software Engineers, share effective Claude usage patterns, and help raise team quality
- Participate in agile ceremonies, break down work, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies
- Coordinate with partner teams on cross-team deliverables. 

Continuous Improvement (5%)

- Identify and implement improvements to codebases, processes, and developer experience. 

Who You Are

- You are a strong full-stack engineer who writes clean, reliable code and sees Claude as an essential accelerator for velocity and quality

Experience You'll Need

- 7-12 years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, etc.) with solid full-stack experience (TypeScript/React or equivalent)
- Practical, hands-on experience with Databricks (pipelines, Delta Lake, optimization) and supporting Python
- Deep SQL skills and experience building or optimizing data systems that deliver insights
- Proven ability to design, implement, and ship complex features with high-quality tests
- Ready and experienced in using Claude extensively for coding tasks and integration testing; able to help others adopt effective practices
- Experience participating in or leading technical design discussions and mentoring more junior engineers

Experience That's a Plus

- Experience with advanced Databricks features, Medallion architecture, or lakehouse optimization
- Prior integration of generative AI tools (Claude preferred) into development workflows
- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms
- Exposure to event-driven architectures, time-series/IoT data, or metadata/catalog systems
- Solar industry or financial/performance analytics domain experience

Culture & Benefits

- We offer a competitive total compensation package bonuses and long-term stock options so you can share in the long-term value you help create as we shape the future together.. 
- We offer a competitive benefits program for our employees and their dependents, including medical, dental, vision, disability and 401(k) administration 
- We love to lift each other up through company-wide slack channels such as #puppiesandpets, #omnidian-wellness, #praiseandbooms and #sustainablefuture
- We have affinity groups to help employees feel seen and supported, such as Rainbow Array, Black Lights Matter, Neurospicy R Us, Puente and more
- We are a passionate, mission driven team that believes in collaboration, mutual respect and trust. For examples, come Discover our Story!

Diversity and Inclusion

We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our customers. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to ensuring our hiring and retention practices, as well as our office culture, reflects this value.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our Philosophy on Pay: The range listed above reflects the starting base salary for most new hires in this role. However, your financial growth doesn't stop at the offer letter. We invest deeply in our people and reward results; annual merit increases can bring your total compensation above this initial range. Our goal is for you to continue growing within the pay band as you sharpen your skills and drive meaningful outcomes.

- Committed to Parity: We eliminate the "negotiation tax" by placing candidates within the band based on verified professional experience and skill set, not bartering ability, and by giving our best offer up front. This is a core part of our mission to ensure gender pay equity and fairness across the board
- Performance Bonus: Exceptional work deserves exceptional rewards. You’ll be eligible for bonuses that reflect your contributions to our collective success
- Continuous Growth: We are a learning organization. To support your evolution, we provide up to $500 in annual learning reimbursement for courses, certifications, or conferences

**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer (MERN) with 4–7 years of experience to develop anddeliver end-to-end features for our SaaS platform. The role involves building scalable React frontends, Node.jsbackend services, APIs, database models and third-party integrations.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
1. Develop backend services using Node.js, Express or NestJS with schema validation (Zod/Joi), centralisederror handling, structured logging, correlation IDs and OpenAPI-documented REST APIs.  
2. Build responsive React/TypeScript applications using shared design systems, React Query/RTK Query,route-level code splitting and accessibility standards.  
3. Design and optimise MongoDB collections using Mongoose, compound indexes, TTL rules and transactions;write efficient SQL queries for reporting and billing.  
4. Implement unit, integration and contract testing; maintain CI pipelines, participate in code/design reviewsand resolve QA and beta defects. Support MVP customer migration through import tools and backward-compatible API development

**Key Technical Focus Areas:**

**A. Tenancy, Identity & Access:**   
1. Implement multi-tenant architecture with tenant resolution through subdomains, headers and token claims.  
2. Develop tenant onboarding/offboarding, plan management, feature flags and tenant-specific configurations.  
3. Integrate OAuth2/OIDC, SAML 2.0 SSO, SCIM provisioning, MFA, JWT access tokens, refresh token rotation and session revocation.  
4. Implement RBAC, resource-level permissions, scoped API keys and security audit logs.

**B. Billing & Metering:**   
1. Integrate billing platforms such as Stripe or equivalent for subscriptions, plans, trials, upgrades/downgrades, proration, coupons, taxes, invoices, payment failures and dunning.  
2. Implement usage metering for media minutes, storage GB and inference jobs using Kafka/queues and idempotency keys.  
3. Build usage aggregation, billing reports, quota enforcement and Redis-based rate limiting.  
4. Implement secure webhook processing, signature verification, replay protection, retries and billing reconciliation.

**C. Media/Map Viewer & Admin Console:**  
1. Develop video playback using HLS.js/WebRTC and timeline scrubbing synchronised with telemetry.  
2. Implement map layers, detection overlays, vector tiles and clustering using Mapbox GL, Leaflet, OpenLayers or CesiumJS.  
3. Build real-time job status and live result updates using WebSockets/SSE.  
4. Develop tenant admin consoles covering users, roles, SSO configuration, plans, usage and audit views.

**Required Skills & Experience:**   
1. 4–7 years of full stack development experience with strong React and TypeScript expertise.  
2. Strong Node.js/Express backend development and REST API design experience.  
3. Hands-on experience with MongoDB, Mongoose, data modelling, indexing, aggregation pipelines and SQL.  
4. Knowledge of OAuth2/OIDC authentication and authorisation patterns.  
5. Experience with Jest/Vitest, Supertest, unit and integration testing, Git workflows and CI/CD.  
6. Understanding of web security principles, including OWASP Top 10, CSRF, XSS, CORS and input validation.

**Preferred Skills / Added Advantage:**   
1. Experience in multi-tenant SaaS application development.  
2. Billing integrations using Stripe, Chargebee or Zuora.  
3. Experience with Mapbox, Leaflet, CesiumJS and HLS.js.  
4. Knowledge of GraphQL, NestJS, Redis and Kafka/RabbitMQ.  
5. Experience with Docker and cloud deployment on AWS or Azure.  
6. Experience using AI coding tools with proper code review discipline.

**Technology stack:**   
React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express/NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose, SQL, Redis, Kafka/RabbitMQ, OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, Stripe (or equivalent), REST/GraphQL, OpenAPI, Jest/Vitest, Playwright, Docker

**Key Deliverables:**   
1. Deliver tested and documented features within sprint timelines.  
2. Maintain OpenAPI specifications and API client updates.  
3. Provide tenant-isolation, billing and viewer test evidence.  
4. Develop customer migration import utilities and operational runbooks.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Apps & Experiences (AppEx) organization powers the unified web user experience (Snowsight) for Snowflake. Every major Snowflake customer interacts with our platform through these surfaces, making AppEx central to both customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

Within Appex, our team sits at the intersection of AI, platform, and user experience. We are on a mission to create an AI‑first, scalable, maintainable, and extensible UI platform from which all Snowflake user experiences can be built. The team owns:

 - The serving layer that powers Snowsight, Snowflake CoWork, and UX features

 - Developer tooling that enable our engineers to move fast and deliver

 - Frontend infrastructure and shared services for product teams

 - CI pipelines that ensure fast and reliable builds

 - Testing and validation platform that maintains code and product quality

 - The monitoring and logging stack that ensures observability and trust

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Snowsight is a large, complex single-page application serving interactive analytics, data engineering, and AI workloads. As our user base and feature surface grow, we must treat performance as a first-class citizen. You will own the strategy, build the tooling, and drive the culture needed to keep Snowsight fast, and you'll partner across our platform and product teams to make performance a default rather than an afterthought.

 

This is a high-leverage role: the systems and practices you build will affect every page load, interaction, and data-rendering path in Snowsight. You will:

 - Define and drive the web performance strategy for Snowsight, setting goals grounded in real user metrics (Core Web Vitals, custom interaction metrics, time-to-visually-complete for data-heavy views).

 - Build and maintain performance infrastructure: RUM/synthetic monitoring pipelines, regression detection in CI, bundle analysis, performance dashboards, and alerting, making performance visible and actionable for every product team.

 - Identify and fix systemic performance bottlenecks across the application lifecycle: initial load, code splitting and lazy loading, rendering (React), data fetching and caching, large dataset rendering (virtualization, streaming), and runtime memory/CPU efficiency.

 - Optimize build and delivery: work with the team on bundle size, tree-shaking, chunk splitting strategies, CDN caching, and resource prioritization (preload, prefetch, HTTP/2+ multiplexing).

 - Establish performance budgets and guardrails integrated into CI/CD so regressions are caught before they ship.

 - Partner with product teams to design performance-aware architectures for new features, providing guidance on data-fetching patterns, rendering strategies, and progressive loading.

 - Mentor engineers across the org on performance best practices, conduct reviews of critical performance paths, and build a culture where teams own performance as a quality attribute.

 - Represent Snowflake's frontend performance perspective in cross-org architectural decisions (e.g., API design, service infrastructure, caching layers) where frontend impact is significant.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Our ideal Staff Software Engineer will have:

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in web performance for large-scale, complex web applications.

 - Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript and React knowledge, including React rendering internals and experience diagnosing and resolving performance issues in large React codebases.

 - Strong understanding of browser performance fundamentals: the critical rendering path, layout/paint/composite pipeline, main-thread scheduling, Web Workers, browser DevTools/Performance panel profiling, etc.

 - Experience designing and operating RUM and synthetic performance monitoring at scale (e.g., custom metrics collection, percentile-based alerting, anomaly detection for regressions).

 - Deep knowledge of build tooling and delivery optimization: Webpack/Vite/Bazel, code splitting, tree-shaking, chunk strategies, lazy loading, CDN behavior, caching headers, resource hints, and their measurable impact on load performance.

 - Experience with large dataset rendering: virtualization (windowing), canvas/WebGL rendering for grids or charts, streaming/incremental rendering, and efficient DOM management.

 - Strong communication and influence skills: able to set technical direction, build consensus across teams, and explain performance trade-offs to both engineers and product stakeholders.

 - Experience working in a platform or infrastructure role where your customers are other engineering teams.

 - Ability to work on-site at our Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA offices.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Familiarity with server-side rendering, streaming SSR, or edge rendering patterns and their performance implications.

 - Familiarity with browser engines or internals (V8, Chromium, Webkit).

 - Contributions to web performance standards, browser APIs, or open-source performance tooling.

 - Experience with observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, etc) and building internal performance tooling.

 - Background in data-intensive UIs: query editors, result grids, dashboards, notebooks, or similar products where rendering performance under large data volumes is critical.

 

If you’re excited about building the platform and systems that power how the world’s largest companies experience Snowflake, we’d love to hear from you.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Native Engineering, Integrations
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

About Team
Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 
Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 
Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On the Integrations team, you’ll own how Flow connects to the systems companies run on, including identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat. You’ll turn them into three things: assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run. Every connection keeps each source’s permissions intact. 
In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 
Types of problems you’ll get to work on 
- Integration generation at scale. We don’t hand-write connectors. Build the pipeline that generates them from whatever a vendor publishes, which is often not a clean OpenAPI spec — and own spec normalization, pinned provenance, and deterministic regeneration across a growing catalog. 

- Tool surfaces an AI can actually call. An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 

- Permissions and credentials you can prove. If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 

- AI-native development itself. Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 

- Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code review, and coaching. Partner with product and design to shape requirements and explain tradeoffs clearly. 

Our stack 
TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list.

To be successful in this role you have: 
- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

- 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

- Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection. 

- Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

- Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

- Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

- A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

Nice to have 
- Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

- Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

- Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

Why join us 
Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 
Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 
 
Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 
Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience.
